SPIRITS-STONE_REMNANTS.title: Stone Remnants
SPIRITS-STONE_REMNANTS.description: Consumed to trigger enhanced [ ] effects. Max 7.
SPIRITS-FLASH.title: Flash
SPIRITS-FLASH.description: When Flash reaches 3: gain 1 Intangible, reduce Flash by 3, and end your turn.
SPIRITS-STATIC_REMNANTS.title: Static Remnants
SPIRITS-STATIC_REMNANTS.description: At the start of your next turn, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to all enemies (unaffected by Strength or Dexterity), then reset to 0.
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT.title: Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT.description: Consumed by Activate Fire Remnant to gain Flash equal to the stack count.
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD.description: When you play an Attack, gain 4 Static Remnants and spend 1 Overload.
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE.title: Real Phase
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE.description: When Static Remnants trigger, resolve the damage again and consume 1 Real Phase.
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE.title: Imaginary Phase
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE.description: When Static Remnants trigger, they are not consumed. Consume 1 Imaginary Phase instead.
